providers.description: Rabbit Mobility (Rabbit) is a clean-tech micro-mobility sharing company operating in Cairo and Giza, Egypt. Through its iOS and Android mobile apps, Rabbit offers shared standing electric scooters and electric bikes with two service models: on-demand "Unlock & Go" rides and multi-day "Day Rentals" that include delivery. The company reports covering more than one million kilometers and saving over 50 tons of CO2 emissions. Rabbit is a portfolio company of 500 Global. As a consumer mobile-app business, Rabbit publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation at this time; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network for discovery and enrichment.

providers.name: VOO (now SideUp)
providers.description: VOO was an Egyptian logistics marketplace that rebranded as SideUp in December 2022, relocating its headquarters to Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. SideUp is a fully integrated courier marketplace that lets e-commerce businesses ship locally and globally from one dashboard, connecting merchants with multiple courier services alongside payment gateways, shipping API integration, warehousing, and fulfillment, with plugins for Shopify, Salla, and OpenCart. Backed by 500 Global, Launch Africa VC, Riyadh Angels, and Alex Angels ($1.2M seed). No public developer portal or API documentation is published as of July 2026.

providers.name: Gravity
providers.description: Gravity (Gravity Technologies) builds and deploys ultra-fast DC electric-vehicle charging infrastructure for dense urban environments. Its Distributed Energy Access Points (DEAPs) deliver up to five-minute charges from compact, modular hardware that requires minimal real estate and no dedicated utility upgrade, letting operators place high-power charging in garages, curbside, and fleet depots. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of GV and Redpoint Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; it publishes no public developer portal, API, or SDKs at this time, so this profile captures company identity and the domain security surface rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Pebble
providers.description: Pebble is a Silicon Valley electric-vehicle and consumer-hardware company that designs and manufactures the Pebble Flow, an all-electric travel trailer (RV) with an integrated battery, solar, and motor-assist drivetrain. The product line pairs the trailer with the Pebble mobile app for remote control and monitoring, offering features such as autonomous "Magic Hitch" coupling, remote-control positioning, automatic leveling and setup, and up to seven days of off-grid capability. Backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners, Pebble sells direct-to-consumer under the tagline "Where Home Meets the Road." As of this enrichment pass Pebble publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or documented API surface; its only software touchpoint is the consumer-facing Pebble Control Center app.

providers.name: Cartrawler
providers.description: CarTrawler is a leading B2B technology provider of car rental, ground transport and insurtech solutions to the global travel industry. Through its Connect Platform it links airlines, online travel agencies and travel companies to a worldwide marketplace of car rental suppliers, private transfers and ride-hailing partners, displaying millions of cars daily and processing billions of queries. CarTrawler serves 70+ airlines and 250+ travel companies worldwide (including American Airlines, Ryanair, easyJet, Qantas, Southwest, eDreamsODIGEO and Uber), differentiating through proprietary technology, real-time machine-learning pricing and personalized retailing. Integration is delivered through partner and supplier programs rather than a public self-service developer portal; this profile was surfaced as an Insight Partners portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: First Club
providers.description: FirstClub is a member-exclusive quick-commerce grocery platform operating in Bengaluru and Hyderabad, India, delivering curated, quality-inspected groceries in as little as 30 minutes from physical "ClubHouses" rather than traditional dark stores. The company targets India's top-tier consumers with only trusted, tasted, and tested products, screening out a published list of banned ingredients across categories including fruits and vegetables, dairy and eggs, bakery, staples, kids nutrition, packaged foods, snacks and beverages, health supplements, and cleaning essentials. FirstClub also offers a subscription model, "FirstClub Mornings." Founded by ex-Flipkart executive Ayyappan R, the company is backed by Accel and RTP Global. It surfaces here as an API Evangelist network profile; FirstClub is a consumer mobile-app business and currently publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation.

providers.name: McDonald's
providers.description: McDonald's is the world's leading global foodservice retailer, operating and franchising fast food restaurants serving hamburgers, chicken, breakfast items, soft drinks, milkshakes, and desserts in countries around the world. McDonald's does not operate a public developer program or publish open API documentation. Its digital surface — the Global Mobile App, MyMcDonald's Rewards loyalty, mobile order & pay, kiosks, and drive-thru personalization — runs on internal platforms, and integrations with delivery marketplaces (DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub) and technology partners (Google Cloud, Dynamic Yield) are bilateral and gated to approved partners and franchisees.

providers.name: Pelikan Mobility
providers.description: Pelikan Mobility is a Paris-based smart-leasing and fleet-management company for electric commercial vehicles, founded in late 2022 by David Salfati and Vincent Schachter. It operates two products: Pelikan Lease, a very-long-term leasing offer (up to 10 years / 300,000 km) for electric utility vans that targets a 20% lower total cost of ownership, and Pelikan FleetPilot, a SaaS platform using digital twins, optimization algorithms and generative AI to plan fleet renewal, electrification and vehicle redeployment across large B2B fleets in utilities, maintenance, construction and logistics. The company is backed by Seedcamp, Frst and PaleBlueDot Ventures. It publishes a marketing and resources website but exposes no public API or developer surface at this time; this profile records its identity and web-domain security posture.

providers.name: Roost
providers.description: Roost is a Sunnyvale, California home-telematics company that helps property and casualty insurance carriers modernize homeowners and commercial insurance with smart, in-home sensors and monitoring. Its Protection360 commercial loss-prevention service and Security360 white-label home-security bundle detect water leaks, extreme temperatures, and smoke-alarm events, delivering real-time alerts and risk data to insurers, property owners, and third parties. Roost partners with dozens of top P&C carriers, but does not publish a public developer API or developer portal; integrations are arranged directly with its engineering team.

providers.name: Sweater
providers.description: Sweater (سويتر) is a Saudi Arabian on-demand mobile car-care company that brings waterless vehicle washing, interior cleaning, detailing, and fragrance services to customers wherever their car is parked. Its app-based platform uses smart scheduling to dispatch field teams by location and uses roughly 7 liters of water per wash versus about 120 liters for traditional methods. The company reports 2M+ washes, 750K+ users, 500+ corporate partnerships, and operations across 8 Saudi cities (Riyadh, Dammam, Khobar, Jeddah, Jubail, Medina, Al-Hassa, and Mecca). Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company. It is a consumer/B2B services business with no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Zolvers
providers.description: Zolvers is a home-services marketplace that connects households with vetted, background-checked domestic and home-maintenance workers across Latin America, operating in Argentina, Mexico, Colombia, and Chile with a focus on Buenos Aires, Mexico City, Santiago, Bogotá, and Monterrey. The platform handles service requests, worker vetting, scheduling, and integrated payment processing for housekeeping and cleaning (one-time and live-in) plus home maintenance such as plumbing, electrical, gas, painting, air conditioning, general repairs, upholstery cleaning, and elder care. Backed by 500 Global, Zolvers is a consumer-facing platform with no public API or developer program at this time.

providers.name: Albemarle
providers.description: Albemarle Corporation is a global specialty chemicals company and leading provider of lithium, bromine, and other essential elements. Operating from its global headquarters in Charlotte, NC, Albemarle serves customers in approximately 70 countries with world-class hard-rock and brine lithium resources, state-of-the-art lithium conversion facilities, advanced lithium material and process development, bromine production facilities, and the US's only producing lithium resource in Silver Peak, NV. The company serves critical markets including electric vehicle batteries, energy storage, flame retardants, pharmaceutical ingredients, catalysts, and specialty chemicals, employing approximately 7,800 people and holding over 1,500 active patents worldwide.

providers.name: Carnot Fleet
providers.description: Carnot Fleet (Carnotfleet) is a Seoul-based cold-chain technology company that converts non-refrigerated vehicles into temperature-controlled units in under 30 minutes using modular insulation panels and proprietary solid-state thermoelectric heat pumps, spanning frozen, chilled, and ambient ranges with humidity control. Its Adaptive Thermal Control System (ATCS) is an AI-based autonomous control platform delivering cloud-connected temperature monitoring at 10-second intervals. Carnot Fleet surfaces its capabilities through the CF Mobile Application, the CF Portal, and CF APIs that let customers integrate the ATCS into existing logistics solutions to detect, analyze, prevent, and discover cold-chain data points and reduce post-harvest to pre-retail loss across the supply chain.

providers.name: EcoG
providers.description: EcoG is a Munich-based technology company that builds the software and hardware platform powering electric-vehicle DC fast chargers. Its EcoG OS operating system, Universal Core platform, and controllers let charger manufacturers, charge point operators (CPOs), and EV businesses design, launch, and scale DC charging solutions with reduced complexity, claiming more than 15% market share in Europe with operations across India and North America. For developers, EcoG OS exposes an on-device programmatic surface (an OpenAPI-based application interface, a local web interface, and the LifeC remote management tool) so smart value-added charging applications can be built and run at the device level. This profile was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and enriched from EcoG's public website; it publishes no public REST API developer portal or specification.

providers.name: Passport
providers.description: Passport (Passport Labs) is a mobility management platform for cities, universities, and agencies, covering digital parking payments, enforcement, permits, and curbside management, and is used by 800+ agencies. Passport exposes a partner developer program at developer.passportinc.com whose REST APIs let parking apps, navigation apps, in-car infotainment, and mobility/POS systems create and stop parking sessions, quote and determine rates, bulk-export the parking environment (zones, spaces, rules), receive parking event schemas, and manage enforcement immobilizations. Rates and rules are configured once by Passport's customers and pushed to payment providers via API. Access is gated - partners register an application, are issued OAuth client credentials by Passport's identity provider, and only authenticated partner applications may call the public APIs. No SDK is required. Commercial terms are partnership / agency-contract based rather than publicly listed self-serve pricing.

providers.name: rabot.energy
providers.description: rabot.energy (RABOT Energy DE GmbH) is a Hamburg-based German electricity supplier offering dynamic and fixed-rate power tariffs where consumers pay hourly rates that track the wholesale electricity market. The company provides 100% renewable energy certified by TÜV NORD, smart meter installation and management, EV charging optimization (Autostrom), and home battery storage (Rabot Flow), all managed through a consumer mobile app for consumption monitoring. It is a consumer-facing energy retailer; no public developer portal or API is currently published. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of HV Capital.

providers.name: blueflite
providers.description: blueflite is a Techstars-backed unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) company that designs and manufactures autonomous cargo and delivery drones built on its SLATE platform for all-weather, time-sensitive logistics. Its aircraft target last-mile shipping and medical or life-saving delivery (such as defibrillators and emergency supplies), and the company complements the hardware with blueDelivery (a consumer ordering app), blueDigital (a cloud productivity tool), and blueControl, alongside drone consulting, engineering, and project services. blueflite is on the FAA Section 44807 approved UAS list and holds FCC conditional approval, and was founded by Frank Noppel and James McClearen. No public developer or API surface is currently published.

providers.name: Agility Robotics
providers.description: Agility Robotics is a Salem, Oregon humanoid robotics company building industrial bipedal robots for warehouse and factory automation. Founded in 2015 as a spin-out of Oregon State University's Dynamic Robotics Laboratory, its flagship product is Digit — described as the first humanoid robot in commercial production deployment — and Arc, the cloud-based automation platform that operates Digit fleets, provides real-time visibility, manages task assignments, and connects Digit to existing warehouse automation including AMRs, WMS, and WES systems. Digit has commercial deployments and pilots with Amazon, GXO Logistics, Schaeffler, Toyota Motor Manufacturing Canada, and Mercado Libre, with an expanded NVIDIA partnership for foundation-model and simulation tooling. Agility operates RoboFab, a humanoid robot factory in Salem, OR with capacity to produce 10,000 robots annually. Digit has surpassed 100,000 totes moved in commercial deployment at a single Georgia facility. Agility Robotics does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or open-source release for Digit or Arc; integration is performed by Agility's solutions team and partners through a gated low-level JSON-over-WebSocket API and pysdk delivered with the robot. The company's public GitHub org primarily contains forks of infrastructure tooling (JFrog, Bazel, Fluent Bit, Kubernetes Cluster API) plus an archived documentation repo for the earlier Cassie research platform.

providers.name: Careem
providers.description: Careem is the everything app for the greater Middle East, a super-app operating across the MENAP region (Middle East, North Africa, and Pakistan) and headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Founded in 2012 and now owned by Uber, Careem combines mobility (rides, taxi, bike, car rental), food and grocery delivery (Careem Eat, Quik), courier and B2B logistics (Box, Express), and financial services (Careem Pay, remittance, donations) alongside the Careem Plus subscription. Careem does not currently operate a public developer API program or partner API portal; this profile captures its public identity, engineering surface, and domain-security posture within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Bayapay Sdn Bhd
providers.description: BayaPay Sdn Bhd is a Malaysian fintech (incorporated 2021, registration 202101021154 / 1421454-H, based in Subang Jaya, Selangor) building programmable, permission-based business and vehicle expense management on an open-loop prepaid Mastercard. Its flagship BayaFuel FuelFleet programme gives fleet operators, SMBs, corporate teams and gig workers real-time spend controls, customizable limits, fraud deterrence and digitized expense tracking across fuel, travel and operational spend. The reloadable prepaid card is issued under license from Instapay Technologies Sdn Bhd (a Bank Negara Malaysia e-money issuer and Mastercard Asia/Pacific licensee), and BayaPay is one of the first Full Functional Open-Loop payment solutions in the APAC region. A 500 Global portfolio company. The public site is Wix-powered and exposes an agent-accessible llms.txt and a hosted Wix Site MCP endpoint; no bespoke BayaPay developer/payments API is publicly documented at this time.

providers.name: Dronamics
providers.description: Dronamics is a European deep-tech company that designs, builds, and operates autonomous long-range cargo drones for middle-mile logistics. Its flagship aircraft, The Black Swan, is a remotely piloted UAV that carries up to 350 kg (770 lb) of cargo over distances up to 2,500 km (1,550 mi), enabling same-day, cross-border, point-to-point deliveries that are faster, cheaper, and lower in CO2 emissions than traditional air freight. Founded in 2014 in Sofia, Bulgaria by brothers Svilen and Konstantin Rangelov and operating as Dronamics Group Limited, the company is building the world's first cargo drone airline, operating a proprietary drone fleet from a network of low-cost droneports. The public dronamics.com marketing site is built on Wix and exposes a Wix Site MCP endpoint for agentic access; Dronamics does not publish a developer-facing logistics API, OpenAPI, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: REGENT Craft
providers.description: REGENT Craft Inc. is a Rhode Island maritime mobility manufacturer building the Seaglider, an all-electric wing-in-ground-effect (WIG) vessel that floats on its hull, hydrofoils, and then flies within a wingspan of the water's surface at up to 180 mph. The company builds the 12-passenger Viceroy, the larger Monarch, and the uncrewed Squire defense drone, and operates a defense product line for ISR, contested logistics and MEDEVAC missions. REGENT is a vehicle manufacturer rather than a software company: it publishes no developer program, no public API and no machine-readable API contract. It does serve a real, hand-authored llms.txt at its website root, which is the only machine-readable artifact on its public surface.

providers.name: Tugende
providers.description: Tugende is a for-profit social enterprise founded in 2012 in Uganda that uses asset finance, technology, and a customer-centric model to help informal-sector entrepreneurs (MSMEs) own income-generating assets through lease-to-own financing — motorcycles (boda bodas), taxis, matatus, boat engines, smartphones, and small-business equipment like salon kits, fridges, and sewing machines. Operating in Uganda and Kenya with 800+ full-time staff, Tugende has served over 52,000 clients. Backed by Partech. Tugende publishes no public API or developer program as of this profile.

providers.name: Ubiq (now NECTURE)
providers.description: Ubiq is a Vienna, Austria mobility-intelligence company (NECTURE GmbH) that rebranded from UBIQ to NECTURE in 2024. Its "distributed operations" SaaS platform turns fleet data into action for shared-mobility operators, business fleets transitioning to EVs, autonomous fleets, and last-mile delivery -- offering automated rebalancing, predictive charging (Charging as a Service), and airport peak services, alongside StreetCrowd, its decentralized community workforce for fleet operations. Founded in 2015 around city parking optimization, it pivoted to shared-mobility SaaS in 2020 and is backed by Speedinvest among other investors. No public developer portal, API documentation, or client packages were found.

providers.name: ARIVE
providers.description: ARIVE (getarive.com) was an urban quick-commerce platform founded in Paris during the COVID-19 pandemic that delivered fashion, beauty, and lifestyle products to customers within hours. Operating across Berlin, Munich, Hamburg, Düsseldorf, Frankfurt, and Paris, it connected more than 500 brands and 200 local stores directly to young, convenience-focused urban shoppers. Backed by Balderton Capital, LaFamiglia, and Triple Point Capital with roughly €31.7M raised, the company ceased operations in mid-2023 following a sale of the business. No public API, developer portal, SDK, or other technical surface was ever published; this profile is retained for network and portfolio-graph completeness.

providers.name: Bliq
providers.description: Bliq is a Berlin-based premium driverless-car subscription service rolling out across Europe. Instead of owning a car or paying per ride, members subscribe monthly to a private autonomous vehicle that Bliq charges, cleans, insures, maintains, and parks on their behalf. Cars are booked for time windows (hours or days) rather than single trips, every journey is remotely supervised by licensed local operators, and there is no surge pricing. Backed by Speedinvest, Bliq positions itself as "ownership without ownership." The company currently operates a consumer marketing site with early-access and waitlist flows and does not publish a public developer API, documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Oto Capital
providers.description: OTO (Oto Capital) is India's leading platform to discover, research, and buy two-wheelers online with embedded financing. It offers digital bike loans with eligibility checks in five minutes and loan approvals within thirty minutes, an EMI calculator, home delivery, and test rides across 22+ Indian cities, working with 10+ lending partners including Northern Arc, Western Capital, Ujjivan Small Finance Bank, and Suryoday Small Finance Bank. Backed by 500 Global. No public developer API, portal, or documentation surface is currently published by the company.

providers.name: Telgani
providers.description: Telgani is an app-based car rental aggregator founded in 2018 and headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Its consumer iOS and Android apps let users compare prices and book cars from more than 50 partner rental companies with over 500 branches across the Kingdom, offering doorstep delivery, airport pickup, and daily, monthly, or yearly rentals. Backed by 500 Global, Impact46, and Elm, Telgani has raised roughly $8.5M across a seed round, a 2021 pre-Series A, and a 2023 Series A. Telgani operates as a consumer mobile marketplace and does not publish a public developer API program; this profile captures its public web properties (homepage, privacy policy, terms of service) and its domain security posture.

providers.name: Turo
providers.description: Turo is a San Francisco-headquartered peer-to-peer car sharing marketplace operating in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, France, and Australia. The platform lets vehicle owners (hosts) list their cars for rent and lets travelers (guests) book those vehicles directly through the Turo app or website, with Turo handling identity verification, insurance, protection plans, payments, and trust and safety on top of the host's inventory. The marketplace covers economy cars, SUVs, trucks, vans, exotic and classic vehicles, and EVs across more than 14,000 cities, and offers contactless Turo Go vehicles where supported. Turo's revenue model is a marketplace take-rate against each trip plus protection plan and ancillary fees, supported by an integrated host operations stack (calendar, pricing, messaging, and earnings) and a guest mobile and web booking experience. Turo does not currently expose a public developer API, SDK, or partner developer portal. The only third-party-facing surface was a now-deprecated ChatGPT plugin (chatgpt.turo.com) launched in 2023 and sunset alongside OpenAI's plugins program in 2024. Integrations with connected-car platforms such as Smartcar are negotiated directly rather than through self-serve developer onboarding, and Turo's public GitHub presence (github.com/turo, github.com/open-turo) is limited to internal engineering tooling, GitHub Actions, ESLint configs, and language-specific libraries rather than a public marketplace API.

providers.name: WeRide
providers.description: WeRide (NASDAQ: WRD) is an autonomous driving technology company founded in 2017 and headquartered in Guangzhou, China. It develops Level 4 self-driving technology across a portfolio of five core products — Robotaxi, Robobus, Robovan, Robosweeper (autonomous sanitation) and advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS) — and operates its fleets in more than 40 cities across 12 countries. WeRide does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures the company's public web presence and domain-security posture as surfaced by the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Wheelocity
providers.description: Wheelocity (Wheelocity Fresh Private Limited) is a Bangalore, India based logistics and supply-chain company building daily fresh-produce and grocery delivery networks for underserved rural markets across India, which it frames as "the access rails for Bharat commerce." Its phygital (online plus offline) model combines location intelligence, IoT hardware, cold-chain and predictive demand forecasting with an electric-vehicle first-mile and last-mile fleet and a consumer app branded WoW. The company reports serving more than one million households, running over 100,000 km of EV movement daily and avoiding tens of thousands of kilograms of produce waste each day. Wheelocity is a venture-backed operating company (Lightspeed Venture Partners portfolio) and, as of this profile, publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: 1hai
providers.description: eHi Car Rental (一嗨租车), operated by Shanghai eHi Information Technology Services Co., Ltd., is one of China's leading car rental and mobility companies. Founded in 2006 and headquartered in Shanghai, eHi offers self-drive car rentals, chauffeured car service, used-car sales, and corporate and government mobility programs across more than 500 cities nationwide, with cross-city return and airport pickup. eHi is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners, added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile. The business operates consumer web and mobile (iOS, Android, HarmonyOS) booking channels; no public developer or API platform was found during enrichment.

providers.name: FREE NOW
providers.description: FREE NOW is one of Europe's leading multi-mobility "super apps," letting riders book taxis and private-hire vehicles and, in many cities, e-scooters, e-bikes, e-mopeds, carsharing and public-transport tickets from a single application. Founded in Hamburg in 2009 as mytaxi and rebranded FREE NOW in 2019, the company operates across nine European countries and 150+ cities. It ran as part of the YOUR NOW mobility joint venture between Mercedes-Benz and BMW and was acquired by Lyft. FREE NOW exposes a partner/business integration API (FREE NOW for Business) through a password-gated developer portal at developer.free-now.com, and maintains an active open-source presence — including the Wave design system — under the freenowtech GitHub organization.

providers.name: Fuse Energy
providers.description: Fuse Energy (originally launched as Tesseract) is a UK-based, vertically integrated energy supplier founded by former Revolut executives Alan Chang and Charles Orr. It buys power from generators and supplies gas and electricity directly to residential and business customers, positioning itself to beat the UK price cap with variable, fixed and multi-rate tariffs, 30-minute billing updates, EV charging, solar/battery export tracking and an in-app AI assistant called "Plugs." The company raised $78M led by Balderton Capital and Lakestar. Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead; as of this enrichment pass Fuse Energy publishes only a consumer-facing web and mobile app and no public developer API, SDK, or documentation.

providers.name: Moove
providers.description: Moove is a mobility fintech providing revenue-based vehicle financing and ownership programs that let drivers acquire cars, motorcycles, and trucks and build businesses on ride-sharing and delivery partner platforms. Applicants apply to Moove, get verified, and start driving toward owning their vehicle, typically within days. Moove partners with major manufacturers including Hyundai, Toyota, Tesla, Volkswagen, and Bajaj, and centers its model on financial inclusion, gender equality, and a hybrid/EV fleet transition. Backed by DCM Ventures and Speedinvest. Moove publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation at this time; this profile captures the company's public identity and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Payment24
providers.description: Payment24 is a white-label payment platform specializing in fuel and fleet payment solutions for oil companies, banks, and retailers, primarily across Africa. Its technology lets clients design and launch branded payment products under their own name — fuel payments and mobile payments, loyalty and rewards, POS terminals, electronic vouchers, B2B and B2C prepaid and store-account cards, EV charging payments, and wet-stock and fuel-in-tank management — alongside banking-grade issuing, acquiring, card management, and merchant management, plus fleet fuel management and telematics. Payment24 operates as a technology partner rather than a public self-serve API provider, so it publishes no open developer portal or API documentation.

providers.name: Enpal
providers.description: Enpal is a Berlin-based residential clean-energy company and one of Germany's market leaders in home solar. It sells and finances complete home energy systems — rooftop solar PV, battery storage, air-to-water heat pumps, EV wallbox chargers, and a dynamic electricity tariff — orchestrated by its Enpal.One+ smart energy-management platform, with flexible purchase and zero-down financing options. Enpal serves over 130,000 German households and operates business (business.enpal.de) and installer partner (enpal.pro) channels alongside its consumer offering. Backed by HV Capital and the SoftBank Vision Fund. This API Evangelist profile was created from a VC-portfolio lead; Enpal publishes a consumer website and customer portal but no public developer API surface at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: The Travelers Companies
providers.description: The Travelers Companies, Inc. (NYSE: TRV) is a leading United States property and casualty (P&C) insurance carrier providing auto, home, and business insurance to individuals, agencies, businesses, government units, and associations. Travelers is a component of the Dow Jones Industrial Average, generated approximately $48.83 billion in revenue in 2025, holds roughly $143.7 billion in total assets, and employs approximately 34,000 people plus 15,000 independent agents and brokers across the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and the Republic of Ireland. The company operates through three reportable segments — Business Insurance, Bond & Specialty Insurance, and Personal Insurance — distributing primarily through a network of independent agents and brokers, and through direct-to-consumer channels for segments of its personal lines. Travelers has a developer portal at developer.travelers.com that surfaces APIs intended for appointed agents, agency-management-system (AMS) vendors, and integration partners; the portal is gated (Salesforce Experience Cloud) and individual API specifications, endpoints, and pricing are not publicly published. The company also publishes the IntelliDrive and IntelliDrivePlus telematics mobile apps used to score personal-auto driving behavior for rating credits.

providers.name: Cyngn
providers.description: Cyngn (NASDAQ: CYN) is a Mountain View, California autonomous vehicle technology company that develops and deploys industrial autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) for material handling. Its flagship DriveMod stack is a vehicle-agnostic, AI-powered autonomy system that retrofits onto standard industrial vehicles such as tuggers and forklifts, paired with the Cyngn Insight fleet-management, teleoperation, and analytics platform and the Cyngn Evolve data toolkit — together marketed as the Enterprise Autonomy Suite. Cyngn targets warehousing, manufacturing, and logistics operators facing labor shortages and safety challenges, and integrates with major warehouse management systems (Manhattan, Blue Yonder, SAP EWM). The company traces its corporate lineage to Cyanogen Inc. (the CyanogenMod company), whose dormant GitHub organization still links to cyngn.com.

providers.name: Papa John's International
providers.description: Papa John's International, Inc. is a major US-based quick-service pizza restaurant chain and Fortune 1000 company operating company-owned and franchised locations worldwide. Papa John's runs consumer-facing online ordering, a Papa Rewards loyalty program, and mobile apps, and integrates with third-party delivery aggregators and restaurant-technology platforms. Papa John's does NOT publish a public developer API or developer portal; its technology surface is internal, franchise-facing, and partner-only. Integrations are arranged through enterprise and franchise partner agreements.

providers.name: Terawatt Infrastructure
providers.description: Terawatt Infrastructure is a US infrastructure company that acquires, develops, owns, and operates purpose-built electric-vehicle charging centers for commercial fleets — medium- and heavy-duty trucking, drayage, autonomous vehicle and rideshare operators. The company sells charging-as-a-service rather than software: it holds real estate and grid interconnection, builds high-power charging sites (including the I-10 electrified corridor and sites near the Ports of Los Angeles and Long Beach), and runs them with its own proprietary Charge Management Software, operations and maintenance program, and a customer reservations portal. Terawatt states publicly that it has implemented the Open Charge Point Interface (OCPI) with custom extensions so fleet customers get visibility into its charging facilities, but it publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable contract for that surface.

providers.name: Evreka
providers.description: Evreka is a smart waste and recycling management technology company offering an end-to-end "Sustainability as a Service" platform that digitizes the entire waste management lifecycle. Its software suite spans operations, fleet, asset, MRF, and workforce management, route optimization, citizen engagement, and EPR/PRO management, complemented by IoT hardware such as fill-level sensors, vehicle and container trackers, and RFID readers. Evreka serves dumpster rental, recycling centers, medical, hazardous and liquid waste, construction and demolition, local authorities, and cross-border waste operators. Backed by 500 Global, it is tracked in the API Evangelist network; no public API or developer portal is currently published.

providers.name: Fernride
providers.description: FERNRIDE (FERNRIDE GmbH) is a Munich, Germany based ground-autonomy company delivering human-assisted autonomous driving for logistics. Its platform automates electric and diesel trucks and terminal tractors across container terminals, yard operations, manufacturing supply, defence logistics, and open-road trucking, pairing on-vehicle autonomy with remote human oversight (teleoperation) for reliability at scale. A centralized Management Suite lets fleet managers monitor and control the autonomous fleet and integrates with existing terminal operating systems (TOS) and yard management systems (YMS). Customers and partners have included DB Schenker, Volkswagen, HHLA, and NVIDIA. FERNRIDE was acquired by Quantum Systems in December 2025. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Speedinvest; the company exposes no public developer portal, API, or documentation surface at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Go X
providers.description: Go X is an electric micromobility sharing company that lets riders rent scooters, e-bikes, and cars on demand, 24/7, through a consumer mobile app. Operating in cities such as New Orleans, Go X builds its own connected electric vehicles and manages fleet access, unlocking, ride sessions, and payments entirely in-app on iOS and Android. It is a consumer-facing mobility service rather than a public API provider: it exposes no developer portal, documentation, SDKs, or documented public API surface (its api.goxapp.com host is the private backend for the mobile apps).

providers.name: Shift EV
providers.description: Shift EV is an electric-mobility company that retrofits existing commercial vehicles to electric power through an "electrofitting" service, converting fleet vehicles to EV drivetrains in under an hour with zero upfront cost. The company designs and installs plug-and-play EV drivetrains, lithium-ion battery packs, on-site charging infrastructure, and fleet-management software for FMCG, e-commerce, service, and OEM fleets. Backed by Union Square Ventures, Shift EV was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface; this profile captures its identity and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Techmate
providers.description: Techmate is an on-demand IT field-services network that provides on-site, boots-on-the-ground ("Smart Hands") technical support across 450+ cities. It matches businesses and overstretched IT teams with certified local technicians for desktop and hardware support, network setup, audio/visual work, IT project management, and staff augmentation, with dashboards to track requests, spend, and work history across distributed offices. Techmate is a services marketplace rather than a developer/API platform; it publishes a public website and blog but no developer portal, API, or documentation surface. Added to the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio lead.

providers.name: Wise Systems
providers.description: Wise Systems provides autonomous routing and last-mile delivery optimization software powered by machine learning. Its platform helps fleet operators plan strategy, optimize and dynamically re-route deliveries, dispatch in real time, track driver performance, and improve last-mile efficiency across industries including auto parts, beverage, building materials, container management, field service, food service, healthcare, linen services, parcel/courier, and retail. Wise Systems exposes an internal "Engine API" during customer implementations to connect data inputs and outputs, but publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or SDKs. Backed by Techstars and headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts.

providers.name: ISAAC Instruments
providers.description: ISAAC Instruments is a Canadian provider of in-cab technology and fleet management for the trucking industry - electronic logging devices (ELD), telematics, hours-of-service (HOS) compliance, driver workflow, messaging, and fuel/performance analytics, delivered as a fully managed hardware-plus-software platform. ISAAC runs an "Open Platform" with a documented API that lets fleets and 80+ integration partners (TMS/dispatch, maintenance, fuel tax, visibility, safety/compliance) share ISAAC data with their chosen vendors. API access is partner-gated - vendors apply through the ISAAC partner program and the full API Guide and reference live behind the ISAAC InRealTime portal and Client Center rather than on a public developer site. The API surface documented here is modeled from ISAAC's public platform and partner materials; exact endpoints, base URLs, and authentication are provisioned to approved partners.

providers.name: Upshift
providers.description: Upshift is a San Francisco fractional car subscription service — "a 2-car garage, in your pocket." Members choose 4, 8, or 12 driving days a month and get a premium Toyota hybrid delivered clean, fueled, insured, and maintained, then picked up when they are done, with plans from $399/month including insurance, delivery, and maintenance. A 500 Global and URBAN-X portfolio company, Upshift publishes no public developer program or API surface; the member experience runs through its iOS/Android apps and go.upshiftcars.com.

providers.name: ClearMotion
providers.description: ClearMotion is an automotive motion-technology company founded out of MIT in 2012 by Zack Anderson and Shakeel Avadhany, headquartered at its US innovation lab in Billerica, Massachusetts, with a UK engineering hub at MIRA Technology Park in Nuneaton, a Shanghai office, and a production plant in Changshu, China. Its CM1 fully active suspension system pairs the ActiValve digital hydraulic actuator with software that counteracts road disturbances in milliseconds, and its RoadMotion service is a crowdsourced, cloud-based road-surface intelligence layer that fuses data from vehicle sensors into a high-definition surface map accurate to better than 20mm, feeding proactive suspension, chassis and ADAS decisions. The company absorbed the Bose Ride and Project Sound active-suspension programs, is led by CEO Christian Steinmann, and ships with NIO (ET9, ES9) alongside collaborations with Porsche, BWI Group and Sona Comstar. Marketing material describes RoadMotion as an "end-to-end cloud API solution", but ClearMotion publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, machine-readable specification, SDKs or /.well-known discovery surface — the API is an OEM/B2B integration rather than a self-serve public API.

providers.name: Konga
providers.description: Konga is a Lagos, Nigeria-based e-commerce company founded in July 2012 and now operating as Nigeria's leading online shopping marketplace, combining a first-party retail business with a third-party seller marketplace across consumer electronics, mobile phones, home appliances, fashion, groceries, beauty, and lifestyle categories. Konga runs a vertically integrated stack alongside its storefront: KongaPay, a Central Bank of Nigeria-licensed and NDIC-insured payments platform offering checkout, transfers, virtual accounts, multi-currency wallets, POS, bill payments, savings, and merchant payouts; Konga Travel & Tours, an IATA-certified travel agency providing flight bookings, hotels, and vacation packages; Konga Health (Medical Direct); Konga Foods/Groceries; KongaNow same-day delivery; and KXpress Logistics for nationwide fulfillment. Konga's revenue model spans marketplace commissions, first-party retail margin, KongaPay transaction fees, logistics fees, travel agency commissions, and seller advertising. Konga does not operate a unified public developer program: the marketplace exposes no documented public REST API for orders, products, or sellers; KongaPay published Android, iOS, and WooCommerce SDKs and SDK docs at kongapay.github.io, but that GitHub organization was archived on July 1, 2023, and the current KPay aggregator API documentation lives at kpayment-org.gitbook.io with limited public surface area focused on POS, Web Payment Gateway, Virtual Account, and Payment Link integrations for approved merchants. As a result, Konga is profiled here as a provider index rather than as an actively documented public-API company.

providers.name: Trucks Venture Fund I
providers.description: Trucks Venture Capital (Trucks VC) is an early-stage venture firm headquartered in San Francisco investing in companies building the future of transportation — making mobility decarbonized, safer, and more accessible. Its focus spans autonomous vehicles, electric aviation, agricultural robotics, fleet management, and mobility infrastructure. Trucks Venture Fund I is the firm's first fund; notable portfolio outcomes include Joby Aviation (NYSE: JOBY), Bear Flag Robotics (acquired by John Deere), nuTonomy (acquired by Delphi), Roadster (acquired by CDK Global), and Zendrive (acquired by Intuit). Surfaced as a portfolio relation of 500 Global and profiled in the API Evangelist network as a venture-capital firm; it publishes a marketing/portfolio website but no developer API surface.

providers.name: Wunder
providers.description: Wunder (formerly Wunder Capital, wewunder.com, now wunderpower.com) is a commercial clean-energy company that deploys solar, battery storage, and EV charging infrastructure across real estate portfolios with no-CapEx energy solutions, managing projects from design through operations in 40+ US states. Backed by Techstars and a $650M partnership with Blackstone, Wunder runs its project development on Astra, a proprietary internal platform for energy data analysis, forecasting, and automation. Wunder publishes no public API or developer program.

providers.name: Aseon Labs
providers.description: Aseon Labs builds robotic pitstops for self-driving cars — distributed robotic micro-depots (the "Aseon Pod") that automate charging, interior and exterior cleaning, and inspection for autonomous vehicle fleets directly within their operating zones, so vehicles reset locally instead of returning to centralized facilities. The company says the approach can cut reset costs by up to 50%, reduce downtime by ~65%, and add $50,000+ in annual revenue per vehicle. Founded in 2026 and backed by Y Combinator (Spring 2026 batch), the Redwood City, CA startup is a physical-infrastructure and robotics company; it does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specifications.

providers.name: Volteum
providers.description: Volteum provides fleet electrification and EV fleet management software that helps companies plan, execute, and operate the transition of their vehicle fleets to electric. The platform covers electrification planning, charging optimisation, and live fleet management, connecting directly to vehicles through OEM APIs across 30+ brands with no hardware installation to track mileage, fault codes, charging sessions, maintenance intervals, and costs across electric, diesel, petrol, and hybrid fleets. Volteum is a Techstars portfolio company and publishes no public developer portal; its telematics and fleet-system API integrations are offered to customers directly.

providers.name: Flix
providers.description: Flix SE is a Munich-based global travel-tech company founded in 2013 that operates an asset-light, platform-based long-distance mobility network across more than 40 countries and 8,000+ destinations. Under the Flix umbrella it runs four consumer brands — FlixBus (green intercity coaches across Europe, North and South America, and Asia), FlixTrain (long-distance rail in Germany and Sweden), Greyhound (North America), and Kâmil Koç (Turkey) — having carried more than 500 million travelers. Flix pairs a technology and data-analytics platform with partner bus operators who run the physical fleet, selling and servicing trips through its consumer apps and website. Flix does not currently publish a public developer API or partner developer portal; its public technical surface is limited to a coordinated vulnerability-disclosure program (security.txt) and the flix-tech open-source GitHub organization. This profile was surfaced as an HV Capital portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: ApnaMart
providers.description: ApnaMart (Apna Mart) is a Bengaluru-based Indian retail and quick-commerce company founded in 2022 by Chetan Kumar Garg and Abhishek Singh. It operates a network of franchise-model neighborhood grocery and FMCG stores combined with a 15-minute delivery app, serving customers across roughly 14 cities including tier-2 and tier-3 markets such as Ranchi, Hazaribagh, and Bilaspur. Backed by Accel, Peak XV, and Fundamentum, the company blends brick-and-mortar retail with on-demand delivery of daily essentials. ApnaMart is a consumer retail business and does not publish a public developer platform or API surface; this profile in the API Evangelist network captures its identity, domain-security posture, and published web properties.

providers.name: Breadfast
providers.description: Breadfast is an Egyptian quick-commerce and online grocery platform, founded in 2017 in Cairo by Mostafa Amin, Muhammad Habib, and Abdallah Nofal. It delivers groceries, freshly baked bread, dairy, fresh produce, ready-to-eat meals, household essentials, pharmacy, and beauty products — more than 7,000 SKUs — to customers in roughly 60 minutes through a vertically integrated network of dark stores and company-owned bakeries, and also operates Breadfast Pay fintech services. The company serves 300,000+ active users across Cairo, Giza, Alexandria, and Mansoura and processes close to a million orders a month. Breadfast runs a consumer WordPress/WooCommerce marketing site and native iOS/Android apps and does not publish a public developer API; this profile tracks the company in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Candela
providers.description: Candela is a Swedish manufacturer of electric hydrofoiling boats and ferries, on a mission to decarbonize waterborne transportation. Its proprietary computer-controlled hydrofoil system, C-Pod electric propulsion, and C-Foil technology lift the hull clear of the water to cut energy consumption by roughly 80% versus conventional planing hulls, enabling silent, long-range, zero-emission travel. Products span leisure craft (the C-8 and C-7 dayboats) and professional vessels (the P-12 electric ferry and shuttle for public and commercial transport). Backed by EQT Ventures, Candela is a hardware and mobility company; as of this profile it publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation. This record captures its public web presence and domain security posture.

providers.name: newmo
providers.description: newmo (newmo株式会社, "ニューモ") is a Japanese mobility company with the mission "移動で地域をカラフルに" — coloring regions through movement. It modernizes regional transportation through a consumer ride-hailing app and taxi service (newmo-taxi.jp), driver recruitment and dispatch, and its newmo Autonomy initiative (newmo.ai), which since 2025 has run Level 4 autonomous-driving taxi trials spanning safety, remote monitoring, operations design, and vehicle integration. newmo is a consumer transportation service rather than a developer/API platform; probing found no public API, developer portal, documentation, or well-known discovery surface. Backed by DCM Ventures.

providers.name: ProLogium Technology
providers.description: ProLogium Technology Co., Ltd. is a Taiwanese energy-innovation company founded in 2006 that develops and manufactures next-generation solid-state lithium ceramic batteries built around a 100% ceramic separator. It commercialized its first solid-state cells in 2013, opened the world's first giga-level solid-state lithium ceramic battery plant in Taoyuan, Taiwan in 2024, and operates a European R&D center at Paris-Saclay with a planned gigafactory in Dunkirk, France. Its product lines span FLCB, PLCB and LLCB cells plus battery modules and packs, targeting electric vehicles, energy storage systems, robotics, and consumer and industrial applications. ProLogium is a hardware manufacturer: it publishes no developer portal, no public API, and no machine-readable API contract of any kind.

providers.name: RIVR
providers.description: RIVR (RIVR Technologies AG, formerly Swiss-Mile) is a Swiss robotics and AI company spun out of ETH Zurich that develops autonomous legged-wheeled robots for doorstep delivery across parcel, grocery, and instant food/convenience segments. RIVR pursues "General Physical AI" by combining large-scale reinforcement learning in simulation with real-world self-supervised learning from live delivery operations, owning the full stack from software to hardware for reliability, safety, and cost efficiency. The company operates commercial deployments with partners including Just Eat Takeaway.com, Swiss Post, Migros Online, Evri, and Veho, and is backed by investors including Hongshan and Bezos Expeditions. This profile is maintained as an API Evangelist network company record; RIVR publishes no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Sidecar
providers.description: Sidecar (side.cr) was added to the API Evangelist network as a Union Square Ventures portfolio lead. The side.cr domain today hosts a transportation news and information content platform (self-described as "building the largest transportation news source powered by everyday people"), covering ridesharing, driving, delivery, safety, and automotive topics for riders and drivers. It is a reader-facing editorial site, not a developer platform: as of this enrichment pass it publishes no API, developer portal, documentation, SDKs, OpenAPI, or any /.well-known discovery surface. The name echoes the pioneering peer-to-peer Sidecar ridesharing company that Union Square Ventures backed and that wound down in 2015, but the current content site states no operational or corporate ties to that defunct service. This profile is retained as a company/lead record with no active API surface to enrich.

providers.name: Camion
providers.description: Camion is an infrastructure-intelligence platform accelerating the electrification of real estate portfolios. Its AI-driven platform indexes properties by their readiness and potential for electrification, forecasts energy demand, and optimizes the placement of solar, storage, and EV-charging infrastructure so the largest real estate owners and infrastructure developers can underwrite and deploy energy upgrades at scale. Camion positions itself as an "always-on energy department" that delivers consultant-grade investment cases without manual dashboard monitoring. Founded in 2023 and based in London, Camion raised a EUR 2.7M pre-seed round led by EQT Ventures in April 2024. Sector: energy-and-environmental. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub; Camion publishes no public developer or API surface at this time.

providers.name: Lucid Motors
providers.description: Lucid Motors is the consumer-vehicle brand of Lucid Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: LCID), a Newark, California–headquartered American luxury electric vehicle manufacturer. The company designs and manufactures high-performance battery-electric sedans and SUVs, with its flagship Lucid Air (Pure, Touring, Grand Touring, and Sapphire trims) and the Lucid Gravity SUV (Touring and Grand Touring), assembled at its AMP-1 factory in Casa Grande, Arizona. Lucid develops its own electric powertrain, battery, and software stack — including the Lucid UX in-vehicle experience, the Lucid mobile app, Lucid Assistant, and over-the-air updates — and operates a vertically integrated direct-to-consumer sales, financing, leasing, and service model across North America, Europe, and the Middle East, supported by a growing network of Lucid Studios, Service Centers, and DC fast charging partnerships. Lucid is majority-owned by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund (PIF). Beyond consumer vehicles, Lucid licenses its powertrain and battery technology to other OEMs (notably Aston Martin) and supplies battery systems through its Lucid energy storage initiatives. Lucid Motors does not publish a public developer API portal, SDK, or OpenAPI specification; the Lucid mobile app and vehicle telematics are powered by private backend services that are not documented for third-party use.

providers.name: Lyten
providers.description: Lyten is a San Jose, California advanced-materials company founded in 2015 that invented and commercializes Lyten 3D Graphene, a tunable three-dimensional carbon supermaterial produced by converting methane into nanostructured carbon while co-producing hydrogen. Lyten applies that materials platform across four product lines: lithium-sulfur battery cells and battery systems that contain no cobalt, nickel or manganese and target roughly 40% weight savings versus lithium-ion; 3D graphene reinforced 3D printer filament; concrete admixture and structural adhesives; and chemical/environmental sensors, including the Lyten Atmos continuous methane-intelligence platform that pairs solar-powered LTE field sensors with cloud analytics and dashboards for landfill and oil-and-gas emissions monitoring. The company has raised over $600 million from investors including Stellantis, FedEx and Honeywell, operates a 145,000 sq ft pilot manufacturing facility in the Alviso district of North San Jose, acquired Cuberg's San Leandro battery assets in 2024, and in 2025 acquired Northvolt battery manufacturing assets in Poland and Sweden, establishing a European headquarters in Gdansk, Poland. Lyten is a private company; its shares trade on secondary markets such as Forge Global. It publishes no public developer API, SDK or developer portal.

providers.name: Bloom & Wild
providers.description: Bloom & Wild is a UK-founded direct-to-consumer flower delivery and gifting company, known for pioneering letterbox flowers that fit through a standard mail slot. Founded in 2013 and headquartered in London, it operates across the UK and Europe under a family of brands including Bloom & Wild, Bloomon and Bergamotte, offering one-off bouquets, plants, gifts and flower subscriptions through its website and mobile apps. Backed by General Catalyst and Index Ventures, it is a consumer e-commerce business rather than a public API provider; this profile captures its public web, security and domain posture. It publishes a /.well-known/security.txt security contact but no public developer program, OpenAPI, or API documentation was found.

providers.name: Humanising Autonomy
providers.description: Humanising Autonomy is a London-based behavioural AI company that builds ethical computer-vision software to understand and predict human behaviour, providing context between people and machines. Its "Behaviour AI" platform combines novel deep learning, behavioural psychology and statistical AI to analyse existing camera and video footage across automotive & ADAS, fleet telematics, city infrastructure & planning, and health & safety use cases -- improving road safety and reducing liability. The company connects to a customer's existing cameras, platform or video footage rather than exposing a public developer API. Backed by Anthemis. NOTE: the primary website (humanisingautonomy.com) is currently unreachable / parked (HTTP 404) as of 2026-07-19, indicating the company may be inactive; this profile is reconstructed from archived (Wayback) sources -- no public API, SDK registry, or developer portal was ever published.

providers.name: Flowbird
providers.description: Flowbird is a global urban mobility and parking technology company that builds pay stations, mobile parking apps, digital permits, EV charging, and transit ticketing systems for cities and transport authorities worldwide. Flowbird was acquired by EasyPark Group in an acquisition that closed in January 2025. Its integration surface is the Flowbird HUB, an open platform that exposes documented but partner/agency-gated APIs (OAuth2 and client-certificate secured, with role-based access control and ownership filters) for tariffs, rights/permits, parking sessions, pay stations, and transactions. There is no self-service public sign-up; access is granted to cities, transport agencies, and integration partners under contract.

providers.name: NEO TECH MOBILITY HOLDINGS LIMITED
providers.description: NEO TECH MOBILITY HOLDINGS LIMITED (Neo Mobility) is a UAE-based B2B electric-mobility startup driving sustainable transportation across the MENA region. Neo bundles electric-vehicle fleets, charging infrastructure, an integrated fleet/driver/operations/energy management platform, driver-safety programs, and human-capital support into a single subscription-based ecosystem — delivering EV Delivery-as-a-Service for e-commerce, food delivery, and last-mile logistics, alongside e-taxi mobility. The company publishes no public developer or API program; this profile is maintained for API Evangelist network discovery.

providers.name: Vayu Robotics
providers.description: Vayu Robotics is a Palo Alto, California robotics company building AI foundation models and sensing for autonomous mobile robots. Its stack spans Vayu Drive, an end-to-end learned, sim-first foundation model for mobility; Vayu Sense, a plenoptic sensor with embodied AI for high-resolution depth perception; a Vayu Sense Development Kit bundled with NVIDIA Orin; and Vayu One, a low-cost autonomous delivery robot for last- and middle-mile delivery. Backed by Khosla Ventures, the company was acquired by Serve Robotics in September 2025. Enrichment probing found no public developer API, SDK, developer portal, or event surface.

providers.name: Dayjob
providers.description: Dayjob is an AI-powered scheduling agent built for waste management and skip hire fleets, operated by Gaea Technology Ltd and backed by Y Combinator (Spring 2026). Its autonomous agents analyze millions of potential route combinations to build optimized daily schedules that factor in travel times, skip sizes, driver availability and priority job assignments, then continuously re-optimize in real time as new jobs, driver changes and exceptions arrive. Dayjob integrates with existing ERP and telematics systems (Weighsoft, PurGo, Wastelogics, plus custom report setups) and claims customers see revenue and efficiency gains, tighter time-window hit rates and materially less planning admin. It is a vertical logistics application rather than an API platform - no public developer portal, API reference or SDKs are published at this time. This profile has been enriched from the company's public website.

providers.name: REEF
providers.description: REEF Technology operates a network of urban logistics and proximity real-estate locations, transforming underutilized spaces such as parking lots into multi-purpose neighborhood hubs for goods, services, and experiences. Through its "Power of Proximity" model and its Ulysses operator program, REEF connects brands, cloud/ghost kitchens, delivery, and mobility services to local consumers while helping property owners diversify revenue. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, REEF is a logistics and real-estate operator; it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Audi Connect / myAudi
providers.description: Audi Connect is the connected-vehicle services platform from Audi AG, the Ingolstadt, Germany-based luxury automaker and member of the Volkswagen Group. Delivered to drivers through the embedded MMI infotainment system and the myAudi companion app for iOS and Android, Audi Connect spans remote vehicle control (lock/unlock, remote start, climate pre-conditioning, EV charge management), safety and security (Emergency Call/eCall, Audi Service Request, stolen-vehicle locator, geofencing, speed alerts), and in-car infotainment (real-time traffic, satellite map imagery, parking and fuel information, weather, news, natural voice recognition, Amazon Alexa, Amazon Music, Wi-Fi hotspot, and an in-vehicle app store with Disney+ and passenger gaming on supported models). Services are packaged as Audi connect CARE (included for ten years on new U.S. Audis), Audi connect NAV (navigation and live traffic), and Audi connect PLUS (premium streaming and Wi-Fi). For EVs and PHEVs, Audi Connect adds charging-station search, remote charge monitoring, and cabin pre-conditioning. Audi does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, OAuth program, or partner SDK for myAudi/Audi Connect; programmatic access today is brokered by third-party connected-car aggregators (Smartcar, High Mobility, Enode, Mojio) under Audi's commercial agreements, and community projects reverse-engineer the mobile-app endpoints. Audi has publicly discussed an internal OpenAPI-driven API management strategy (with Nagarro) but the surface remains private to Audi, VW Group brands, and authorized partners.

providers.name: Dada
providers.description: Dada Group (Dada Nexus, NASDAQ: DADA) is a leading Chinese instant retail and local on-demand delivery platform, headquartered in Shanghai and founded in 2014. It operates an open, crowdsourced delivery network of more than one million rider partners serving supermarkets, pharmacies, fresh-food and restaurant merchants across thousands of counties and cities, alongside merchant fulfillment products such as the Haibo in-store logistics system and the Dada Youjian picking service. Now integrated into the JD.com ecosystem, its core delivery brand was rebranded to JD Instant Delivery (京东秒送) in May 2024. Dada runs a merchant Open Platform (开放平台) for order, delivery-tracking and fulfillment integrations. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Hongshan and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Tezbor, Inc.
providers.description: Tezbor is a Tashkent, Uzbekistan based courier and last-mile logistics company that automates the delivery of documents, parcels, and cargo across Uzbekistan. Beyond its consumer and business courier service, Tezbor operates a technology platform that exposes delivery ordering and tracking through an integration API, ready-made e-commerce plugins (WooCommerce, OpenCart, Magento), mobile apps, dashboards, and Telegram bots, so that any online store can automatically generate a Tezbor delivery order from each purchase. The company is backed by 500 Global, Activat, and StartupBase, and counts brands such as Beeline, Ozon, and OQ among its delivery clients.

providers.name: Aerialoop
providers.description: Aerialoop is a drone technology and urban logistics company that designs, builds, and operates intelligent aerial networks for cargo delivery, surveillance, and infrastructure inspection. Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Miami with operations rooted in Quito, Ecuador, it is one of the fastest-growing drone delivery operations in Latin America. Its ALT 6-8 delivery drone carries a 5kg payload for urban logistics, while the ALT 6-ISR line adds HD, infrared, and night-vision cameras with AI-powered intrusion detection; extended-range variants operate up to 120km using LEO satellite connectivity for beyond-visual-line-of-sight flights. The company has completed over 50,000 flights across six countries. Aerialoop is a Techstars Miami (powered by J.P. Morgan) portfolio company. It currently publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: EQUIPTAL HOLDING LTD
providers.description: EQUIPTAL HOLDING LTD operates Moedatech (معداتك), Saudi Arabia's first digital procurement and rental marketplace for heavy construction equipment, connecting contractors with verified suppliers of excavators, cranes, and trucks through RFQs, real-time bidding, and audit-ready digital contracts. Founded in Riyadh in 2020 by Ali Merie and Mansour Hmaid, the company pairs the marketplace with a telematics/fleet layer (built on Traccar GPS tracking) so equipment owners can monitor real-time asset performance. The product ships as iOS and Android apps plus a web app; there is no publicly documented developer API at this time. The company is backed by 500 Global and Plug and Play Middle East. This profile was surfaced from the 500 Global portfolio and enriched from the company's public web, brand (moedatech.net), and GitHub presence.

providers.name: CHINT
providers.description: CHINT (Chint Group) is a global smart-energy and intelligent-electrical solutions provider founded in 1984 and headquartered in Wenzhou, China, with operations across more than 140 countries. Its portfolio spans low-voltage electrical equipment (IEC and UL), power transmission and distribution systems, switchgear, instruments and meters, EV charging, and clean-energy systems including solar PV and battery storage, serving power utilities, buildings, telecom and data centers, industrial, and OEM sectors. CHINT does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI definition, or developer portal; this profile captures the company identity and its public web properties. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Hongshan (HongShan / former Sequoia China).

providers.name: Kaizen
providers.description: Kaizen Labs is a New York City civic-technology company building a modular platform that helps local, state, and federal government agencies serve constituents simply, securely, and at scale. Founded in 2022 by Nikhil Reddy and Kj Shah, the platform spans permitting and licensing, recreation reservations and registrations, parking management, tolls and transit fare collection, e-billing and tax payments, DMV and judicial-court services, and AI-assisted case management — reaching roughly 40 million residents across 50+ agencies in 17 states. Kaizen has raised about $35M from NEA, Andreessen Horowitz, Accel, 776, and Carpenter Capital. The company publishes no public developer API surface; this profile is enriched from its public website, llms.txt, and security & compliance disclosures.

providers.name: Mitra Chem
providers.description: Mitra Chem is an AI-enabled innovator and manufacturer of battery and critical materials for energy, AI infrastructure and defense applications, founded in 2021 and headquartered in Mountain View, California. Its first commercial product is iron-based lithium iron phosphate (LFP) and lithium manganese iron phosphate (LMFP) cathode active material produced for Western battery cell makers and energy-storage OEMs as a non-China supply source. The company operates The Foundry, an instrumented shared pilot manufacturing facility spanning wet chemistry, hydrometallurgy, particle sizing, drying and heat treatment, and runs an internal full-stack AI platform of physics-based models, digital twins and engineering co-pilots used to compress materials scale-up cost and timelines. The AI platform is internal tooling for Mitra Chem's own manufacturing operations; it is not sold or exposed as a software product, and the company publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable interface.

providers.name: IKEA U.S.
providers.description: IKEA U.S. is the United States retail operation of IKEA, run by Ingka Group, the largest IKEA franchisee. The U.S. business operates ~50+ full-service stores, ~40+ Plan & Order Points, and ~80+ pick-up locations across the country, alongside the ikea.com/us e-commerce site and the IKEA mobile app. Inter IKEA Systems B.V. separately owns the IKEA Concept and brand. IKEA U.S. offers home furnishings, kitchens, appliances, lighting, the IKEA Family loyalty program, the IKEA Business Network for B2B customers, home delivery and Click & Collect, design and planning services, the Buy Back & Resell program, and IKEA Home smart products controlled via the IKEA Home smart and IKEA Home smart 1 apps. IKEA U.S. does not publish a public developer API; supplier and trading-partner integrations are handled through IKEA's vendor systems and Ingka Group's internal digital platforms.

providers.name: Automatic
providers.description: Automatic (Automatic Labs, Inc.) was a San Francisco connected-car company founded in 2011 by Thejo Kote and Jerry Jariyasunant. Its OBD-II adapter and companion mobile app turned almost any car built since 1996 into a connected car, adding trip logging, fuel and MPG tracking, engine-light diagnostics, parking recall, and automatic crash alerts. Automatic ran a public developer platform at developer.automatic.com built around three surfaces: a REST API exposing trip, user, and vehicle data; an Events API delivering real-time driving events such as ignition on/off, hard braking, acceleration, speeding, and location changes over webhooks and websockets; and a private-beta Streaming SDK that read raw OBD-II data from the second-generation adapter over Bluetooth. SiriusXM acquired the company on 2017-04-27 for approximately $115 million, and all operations were shut down on 2020-05-28. THIS COMPANY IS DEFUNCT — no API, developer portal, or documentation remains online, and the automatic.com domain now belongs to the unrelated company Automattic. This profile is retained as a historical record of a notable connected-car API platform.

providers.name: Yoshi
providers.description: Yoshi Mobility is a mobile vehicle-care and fleet-services platform founded in 2015 (Y Combinator S16). It brings automotive services to the vehicle wherever it is parked: mobile maintenance and oil changes, car washes and detailing, tire and battery service, EV charging, and live-video vehicle inspections that produce API-ready, signed results for fleets and rideshare platforms. Yoshi originally pioneered on-demand fuel delivery (that division was acquired by EZFill Holdings in January 2025) and now concentrates on mobile auto care and inspection technology, backed by strategic investors including General Motors Ventures, Bridgestone, and ExxonMobil. Integrations and APIs are offered to partners through direct sales rather than a public self-service developer portal.

providers.name: Aora
providers.description: Aora (Aora Servicios) is a Mexico-based on-demand home and office services marketplace that connects households and businesses with vetted technicians and providers for repairs, installations, and maintenance. Its catalog spans home and office repairs, white-goods and appliance service, air conditioning and mini-split installation, water heaters, plumbing and drainage, waterproofing, and home-technology work. Consumers browse and book services through the Aora web app and the Aora mobile app, while a B2B program serves business customers. The company is backed by 500 Global. Aora publishes a consumer-facing website and blog but does not currently expose a public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs; this profile captures its public web surface and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Avis Budget
providers.description: Avis Budget Group is a leading global provider of vehicle rental and mobility solutions with brands including Avis, Budget, Budget Truck, Payless, and Zipcar.

providers.name: BYD
providers.description: BYD Company Ltd. is a Chinese multinational manufacturing conglomerate headquartered in Shenzhen, founded in 1995 by Wang Chuanfu and publicly listed in Hong Kong (1211) and Shenzhen (002594). Originally a rechargeable-battery maker, BYD has grown into one of the world's largest producers of new-energy vehicles (battery-electric and plug-in hybrid cars, buses, and trucks), power batteries (including the Blade Battery), consumer and automotive electronics, rail transit systems (SkyRail/SkyShuttle), forklifts, and solar and energy-storage products. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of hongshan and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; BYD is a hardware and manufacturing company and does not publish a public developer or API program.

providers.name: Citymapper
providers.description: Citymapper is a London-based urban transit and journey-planning company, founded in 2011, that operates a consumer mobile app for iOS and Android covering more than 80 cities worldwide. The app combines public transit (bus, rail, metro, tram, ferry), micromobility (bike share, scooter, e-bike), ride-hail, walking, and driving into multi-modal routes with real-time arrivals, disruption alerts, step-by-step navigation, fare comparisons, and journey-saving features such as Get Me Somewhere, Go, and Citymapper CLUB (its paid premium subscription). In March 2023 Citymapper was acquired by Via Transportation, the New York-based TransitTech company that supplies on-demand transit, paratransit, and network-planning software to cities and transit agencies; Via integrates Citymapper as the rider-facing layer of its end-to-end transit platform alongside Remix (network planning) and Via's own on-demand operations software. Citymapper additionally offers a B2B advertising platform (ads.citymapper.com) targeting urban commuters. Citymapper previously published a self-service Directions API, a Navigation SDK (iOS, Android, Web), and Travel Time / Routing endpoints, but discontinued all self-serve developer products on 23 June 2023; remaining transit-data and routing integrations are now delivered under enterprise contracts through Via Transportation rather than via a public developer portal. There is no current public OpenAPI specification, self-serve API key, or open-access developer documentation for Citymapper.

providers.name: Fantasmo
providers.description: Fantasmo builds CPS (Camera Positioning System), a computer-vision positioning technology it positions as a "camera-powered GPS replacement" delivering hyper-accurate localization that works indoors and in dense urban environments where satellite GPS degrades, using only a device camera and a data connection rather than additional infrastructure. Its target applications span micromobility (scooter/bike tracking and theft prevention), robotics navigation, mobile augmented-reality experiences, and automotive lane-level positioning. Fantasmo was a Techstars-backed startup and was acquired by Niantic in 2022; the public fantasmo.io site remains online but exposes no developer portal, API reference, SDK, or OpenAPI surface at this time. This profile was enriched from the provider's public web presence and live DNS/TLS/HTTP probes.

providers.name: Northvolt
providers.description: Northvolt AB is a Swedish lithium-ion battery developer and manufacturer, founded in Stockholm in 2016, that built and operated the Northvolt Ett gigafactory in Skelleftea and the Northvolt Labs R&D and qualification campus in Vasteras, with further sites in Heide (Germany), Gdansk (Poland) and Montreal (Canada). Its product line covered lithium-ion, sodium-ion and lithium-metal cells, the Voltpack Core and Voltpack Mobile System battery energy storage systems, the Revolt battery recycling operation, and a Connected Battery telemetry and fleet-management service. Northvolt AB filed for bankruptcy in Sweden on 12 March 2025; through 2025 its remaining assets in Sweden, Germany and Poland were acquired by Lyten. The company never published a public developer program, API reference or machine-readable API contract; its only named developer-facing surface, api.northvolt.com, no longer has a reachable origin.

providers.name: Polestar
providers.description: Polestar is a Swedish premium electric performance car brand, originally spun out of Volvo Cars' Polestar Performance racing arm and now jointly owned by Volvo Cars and Zhejiang Geely Holding Group. Headquartered in Gothenburg, Sweden and publicly listed on Nasdaq (ticker PSNY) since 2022, Polestar designs and sells a lineup of battery-electric vehicles — Polestar 1 (discontinued hybrid GT), Polestar 2 (fastback), Polestar 3 (SUV manufactured in South Carolina and Chengdu), Polestar 4 (SUV coupe), and the upcoming Polestar 5 GT. The vehicles run a Google Automotive Services–based infotainment platform with Google built-in (Maps, Assistant, Play Store), and support NACS-compatible DC fast charging in North America. Polestar emphasizes sustainability through the Polestar 0 project (climate-neutral car by 2030) and partnerships with Circulor for battery traceability.
